title: The practices table's View link and placement button are 24px targets again, so /admin/content/practices passes axe target-size on desktop and mobile

source.ref: LIVE-213 cause (c), named in #3109 (pr-compare run 36678631457, e2e-manual smoke job 109734068949); introduced by LIVE-643 (#3032); ADR-1698

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-09-30 (ADR-1698), one of the three regressions LIVE-213's recapture (#3109) left on main. THE CONSEQUENCE: /admin/content/practices read 40 serious+ axe target-size violations against a baseline of 0, desktop and mobile, failing pr-compare's a11y step on every PR. LIVE-643 (#3032) put PracticePlacementButton (practice-placement.tsx, a p-0.5 button around a 14px Compass: 19.1 px) beside each unplaced row's View link (practices-table.tsx, a bare Link around a 12px ExternalLink: 12.8 px) with gap-1.5 between them, so neither met WCAG 2.2 target-size (24 px, or 24 px of clear spacing). THE FIX: both are `inline-flex h-6 w-6 items-center justify-center` boxes with the icons unchanged (h-3 w-3 and h-3.5 w-3.5), the placement button drops its p-0.5, and the View link gains the same rounded hover fill the placement button already had. The four admin-content-practices baselines are recaptured through e2e-manual.yml (update_baselines + capture_shell) against this branch's preview, since the title line of each row is now 24 px tall. Readings in the PR body.
